'''Gibb''' was a port mechanic in the city of [[Lesvol]] on [[Prishardia]] where he tried to repair the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of the ''[[Star Lady]]''. When [[Ghitsa Dogder]], [[Fenig Nabon]] and [[Kyp Durron]] came under fire from the [[Rook (720 light freighter)|''Rook'']], Gibb came to the rescue in the repaired ''Star Lady''.
